identity.ops_surface: managed through OpenTofu-owned infrastructure and root Makefile/oya ops targets; no manual SSH troubleshooting path
identity.suite_boundary: unified communications shell; each child owns domain runtime but shares persona, policy, search, notification, and audit seams

acceptance_criteria.given: a user has both personal and work persona grants
acceptance_criteria.then: every read/write carries immutable context_kind and ownership_pillar; cross-pillar joins are denied

acceptance_criteria.given: mail, messenger, and calendar apps are enabled for a tenant
acceptance_criteria.then: the same policy, audit, search, and notification seams are reused without child apps bypassing the suite shell

acceptance_criteria.given: an org admin requests personal-context data
acceptance_criteria.then: the request returns 403 and emits a blocked-boundary audit event without exposing content

acceptance_criteria.given: a professional artifact is under legal hold
acceptance_criteria.when: a deletion, retention expiry, export, or Workflow handoff touches it
acceptance_criteria.then: hold state wins, chain-of-custody is preserved, and the action is audit logged
Connect runtime state is managed through Makefile/oya ops paths with no manual SSH troubleshooting contract

acceptance_criteria.given: the suite shell receives an inbound message for any child app
acceptance_criteria.when: DMARC/DKIM/SPF evaluation is complete at the suite perimeter
acceptance_criteria.then: authentication result is stamped on the artifact envelope before child-app processing; reject/quarantine follows policy

acceptance_criteria.given: a user is signed into multiple identities (personal + multiple work tenants)
acceptance_criteria.then: each identity is isolated in its own pillar namespace; notification badges do not cross identity boundaries

ops state changes are OpenTofu/oya ops driven, not SSH runbooks

multi-identity users: each identity gets isolated notification namespace and pillar boundary
